findings.quote: The combined organic layers were washed with brine (25 mL)
findings.message: The brine-wash separations should retain the organic phase, rather than mark the retained phase unknown. This also applies to the three brine washes after redissolution in Et2O. Organic versus aqueous identity does not require assigning top versus bottom.

Both evaporations omit the explicitly specified vacuum condition from the operational representation. The uncertainty about unspecified numerical pressures does not preserve the known use of vacuum. Because Evaporate has no qualitative vacuum field, retain this condition in unmapped_actions.
